{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Catatonia''' was a medical condition characterized by the lack of activity in the conscious mind, leaving the body inert. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] political agitator [[Cyndra]] was rendered catatonic in an encounter with [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] during which Zannah attacked her with [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|illusions]].<ref name="DBII 13">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> Due to the high degree of mental and emotional integration exhibited by the [[Hive mind/Legends|communal intelligence]] of the [[Bilar]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Death/Legends|death]] of a single member of a group was often enough to send [[Gender/Legends|his or her]] mates into a catatonic state.<ref name="GG4b 20">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>

[[Ysanne Isard]]'s attempts to turn captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilot [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] into a ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' style [[Sleeper Agent|sleeper agent]] rendered him catatonic, and thus unsuitable for use as an agent. Catatonia was not uncommon for those Isard was unable to turn into sleeper agents.<ref name="KrytosTrap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Real-world [[Wikipedia:Catatonia|catatonia]] is not recognized as a separate disorder, but rather a symptom of a disorder due to either the effects of a medical condition, the presence of a mood disorder, or a feature of [[schizophrenia]].<ref name="DSM-IV GMC">{{BookCite|author=American Psychiatric Association|title=Diagnostic and Statistical Manual for Mental Disorders|version=Fourth Edition|publisher=American Psychiatrics Publishing}}</ref>
